metadata.Name: STAIR-Captions
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese image caption dataset from translated and cleaned MS-COCO captions.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 55th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 2: Short Papers)
metadata.Venue Name: 55th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
metadata.Abstract: Image captioning, which is the task of automatically generating a descriptive sentence for an image, has attracted a great deal of attention. Although neural-network-based models have shown promising results for this task, the performance of these models heavily relies on the availability of a large-scale dataset of image-caption pairs. However, for most languages other than English, such as Japanese, there are no such large-scale datasets. In this paper, we construct a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset, which we call STAIR Captions. We collected 820,360 Japanese captions by translating and cleaning English captions in the MS-COCO dataset. We also report a baseline result of an image captioning model trained with our dataset, which shows the usefulness of our dataset. The constructed dataset is publicly available.
